domain: Bias arising from period and carryover effects (crossover trials)
signalling_question: Risk-of-bias judgement for this domain
guidance: Domain added for crossover trials. Judge S.3 by comparing the washout length with how long the outcome takes to return to baseline after NR stops; use second-baseline (start of period 2) values when the trial reports them, and record the evidence used. Low needs balanced sequences (or period effects in the model) and an adequate washout. High if carry-over is likely and not addressed. Otherwise Some concerns (summary).
